name: pr-agent
description: 🚀 PR Agent: The Original Open-Source PR Reviewer. This project is not the Qodo free tier.
one_liner: An AI bot that automatically reviews code changes on GitHub and leaves comments, like a tireless extra reviewer on every pull request.
buyer: An engineering manager at a 10-30 person startup who can't afford to have senior engineers review every junior PR line by line.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools reseller offers a managed, hosted version with custom review rules (security, style, compliance) sold per-seat to small engineering teams who don't want to self-host.
A code-quality consultancy configures and tunes it for clients' specific coding standards as a fixed-fee setup service.
A compliance-focused version is sold to regulated industries (fintech, healthcare) with custom rule packs enforcing their specific audit requirements.

money_ideas.idea: Hosted SaaS with custom rule packs and a dashboard, billed per seat per month.
Fixed-fee setup and rule-tuning service for teams wanting it configured to their exact standards.

steal_this: This exact idea is already a funded company (Qodo) built on this same open-source core — the honest weekend project is a narrow vertical version (e.g. 'PR reviewer specialized in Solidity/smart contracts') rather than competing head-on.
